{"seon.dev.mcp/namespace":"scratch.astra.store","seon.dev.mcp/session-id":"default","seon.dev.mcp/cluster":"default","seon.dev.mcp/mode":"jvm","seon.dev.mcp/events":[{"tag":"ret","val":"#:seon.dev.mcp{:value [[{:n 1, :label "patch", :ms 2.011709, :operations {:pull 4}, :entities 1, :tempids 1} {:n 1, :label "batched", :ms 0.570042, :operations {:pull 2}, :entities 1, :tempids 1}] [{:n 10, :label "patch", :ms 9.743875, :operations {:pull 40}, :entities 10, :tempids 10} {:n 10, :label "batched", :ms 3.74975, :operations {:pull-many 2}, :entities 10, :tempids 10}] [{:n 100, :label "patch", :ms 79.154916, :operations {:pull 400}, :entities 100, :tempids 100} {:n 100, :label "batched", :ms 30.3105, :operations {:pull-many 2}, :entities 100, :tempids 100}]], :windowed? false}","ns":"scratch.astra.store","ms":541}],"seon.dev.mcp/runtime":"clj","seon.dev.mcp/cluster-state":"advertised","seon.dev.mcp/form":"(do (defn measure-test-report-renders [renderers]
  (let [held (:seon.store/store (#'boot/selected-instance "default"))
        base (db/db (boot/connection "default"))
        findings (vec (take 100 (sort (db/q '[:find [?id ...] :where [_ :seon.test/sym ?id]] base))))]
    (mapv
     (fn [n]
       (let [branch (keyword (str "astra-report-" (id/id)))
             _ (registry/branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch branch
                                  :seon.cluster.registry/from (:datahike.value/commit-id (db/committed-value-identity base))})
             conn (store/open-branch! held branch)]
         (try
           (let [rows (db/pull-many base [:seon.test/sym :seon.test/pass-count]
                                   (mapv #(vector :seon.test/sym %) (subvec findings 0 n)))
                 tx (mapv (fn [i row] (assoc (update row :seon.test/pass-count (fnil inc 0)) :db/id (str "finding-" i))) (range n) rows)
                 report (db/transact! conn tx)
                 _ (assert (:db-after report))
                 answers (mapv
                          (fn [[label f]]
                            (let [reads (atom []) start (System/nanoTime)
                                  answer (binding [db/*read-evidence-sink* reads] (f report))
                                  ms (/ (- (System/nanoTime) start) 1e6)]
                              {:n n :label label :ms ms :answer answer
                               :operations (frequencies (map #(get-in % [:seon.db/read-request :seon.db/read-operation] :index) @reads))}))
                          renderers)]
             (assert (apply = (map :answer answers)))
             (mapv #(-> % (assoc :entities (count (:seon.db.report/entities (:answer %)))
                                 :tempids (count (:seon.db.report/tempids (:answer %))))
                          (dissoc :answer)) answers))
           (finally (store/release-branch! conn)
                    (registry/retire-branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch branch})))))
     [1 10 100])))
 (measure-test-report-renders [["patch" render-transaction-candidate] ["batched" render-transaction-batched]]))","seon.dev.mcp/root":"/Users/sean/src/seon"}
